name: quest
description: Qualitative Evaluation und Untersuchung von Sprachmodellen Tool
author: Robin Nicolay, Felix Gratzkowski, Sebastain Bader

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: shx rm -rf ./dist && npm run build_client && npm run build_server
scripts.build_client: cd ./client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build_server: cd ./server && npm install && npm run build && shx cp -R ./dist ../dist
scripts.release: shx rm -rf ./release && npm run build && npm run copy_DistAssetsToRelease && npm run build_binaries
scripts.copy_DistAssetsToRelease: shx mkdir release && shx cp ./dist/config.json ./release/config.json && shx cp ./dist/README.md ./release/README.md
scripts.docker_push_linux: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t robinsuncruiser/quest . && docker push robinsuncruiser/quest
